_purpose: D2 — Representational Similarity Analysis (Spearman rank-correlation on pairwise-distance matrices) between zA (measurement-MLP) and zB (passive-CNN) on the §5.7 baseline at lambda_C=0.0 (pre-alignment condition).
_notes: Hyperparameters intentionally identical to D1 so the (zA, zB) pair is the same up to bootstrap-RNG; this lets D1 (CKA) and D2 (RSA) be compared on a common substrate.
Reports both Euclidean and cosine RSA (Spearman of pdist vectors), each with 95% (2.5/97.5 percentile) bootstrap CI computed by resampling rows of the (zA, zB) eval matrix.
If n_eval_paired < 100, runner aborts and writes HONEST_NEGATIVE per spec.
Tie warning: if any pdist vector has more than 25% tied entries, result records a warning (Spearman degrades with ties).
